subject: Filename too long in merging samples

messages.author: 6d2491f0b1973f74
messages.subject: Filename too long in merging samples
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to merge samples using the command 'unite'. 

I have 25 samples for the treatment group and 22 samples for the control group. I have created myobjDB using 'methRead' with the options dbtype="tabix",dbdir="methylDB". 

Now, when trying to merge the samples using:

meth.min=unite(myobjDB,min.per.group=1L)

I get this error: 

compressing the file with bgzip...
Error: 'bgzip' error: opening 'file': File name too long

It seems that it's trying to concatenates the name of all the single 47 files into the merged ones. I assume there is a character limit for a file name. 

Do you know how to fix this? Basically, how do I merge the samples together but shortening the merged filename? 

Thank you
Federico

On Wed, Jan 25, 2017 at 8:25 PM,  <federic...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I am trying to merge samples using the command 'unite'. 

I have 25 samples for the treatment group and 22 samples for the control group. I have created myobjDB using 'methRead' with the options dbtype="tabix",dbdir="methylDB". 

Now, when trying to merge the samples using:

meth.min=unite(myobjDB,min.per.group=1L)

I get this error: 

compressing the file with bgzip...
Error: 'bgzip' error: opening 'file': File name too long

It seems that it's trying to concatenates the name of all the single 47 files into the merged ones. I assume there is a character limit for a file name. 

Do you know how to fix this? Basically, how do I merge the samples together but shortening the merged filename? 

Thank you
Federico
